title: CCR2 is localized in microglia and neurons, as well as infiltrating monocytes, in the lumbar spinal cord of ALS mice
note: Shows that peripheral immune cells infiltrate the ALS spinal cord and fuel neuroinflammation, supporting the paper's premise of an immune component to motor neuron degeneration.

title: The pathogenic role of c-Kit+ mast cells in the spinal motor neuron-vascular niche in ALS
note: Documents immune cell accumulation around degenerating motor neurons in human and mouse ALS, reinforcing that the ALS lesion is an immunologically active site.

title: Neuroinflammation in motor neuron disease
note: Review of the neuroinflammatory and adaptive-immune changes in ALS, giving general context for an autoimmune response against a neuronal protein.

title: Regulatory T-lymphocytes mediate amyotrophic lateral sclerosis progression and survival
note: Reports that reduced Treg numbers and FoxP3 expression track faster ALS progression in patients, a central observation the paper's autoimmune framing builds on (carries a published erratum, no retraction or concern).

title: Regulatory T cells for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/motor neuron disease: A clinical and preclinical systematic review
note: Systematic review and meta-analysis finding that boosting Tregs prolongs survival in ALS models, supporting the therapeutic rationale for Treg-based intervention.

title: Immunosuppressive Functions of M2 Macrophages Derived from iPSCs of Patients with ALS and Healthy Controls
note: Shows that iPSC-derived M2 macrophages, including C9orf72-mutant lines, can convert ALS effector T cells into functional Tregs, pointing to a route for restoring Treg-mediated suppression.

title: CD4+ T cell expression of the IL-10 receptor is necessary for facial motoneuron survival after axotomy
note: Demonstrates that IL-10 signalling through CD4+ T cells is required for motoneuron survival, linking IL-10, T cells, and neuroprotection directly to motor neurons.

title: Loss of IL-10 Promotes Differentiation of Microglia to a M1 Phenotype
note: Shows IL-10 restrains microglia from a pro-inflammatory M1 state, supporting IL-10 as an anti-inflammatory, neuroprotective mediator in the CNS.

title: Microglia-specific IL-10 gene delivery inhibits neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration
note: Targeted IL-10 delivery to microglia reduces neuroinflammation and rescues neurons in a Parkinson model, offering proof of concept that raising IL-10 is neuroprotective.

title: Expanded autologous regulatory T-lymphocyte infusions in ALS
note: Phase 1 trial where autologous expanded Treg infusions were safe and slowed ALS progression in proportion to Treg suppressive function, the clearest clinical support for Treg-based therapy in ALS.

title: A phase 2 randomized trial with autologous polyclonal expanded regulatory T cells in children with new-onset type 1 diabetes
note: A single dose of polyclonal Tregs failed to alter type 1 diabetes progression, illustrating the limits of non-specific Treg therapy and motivating antigen-specific approaches.

title: Synergistic targeting of immunologic pathways to empower durable tolerance therapies
note: Argues for antigen-specific, combination strategies to induce durable immune tolerance, framing the therapeutic logic of targeting a defined autoantigen.

title: Quantitative Predictions of Peptide Binding to Any HLA-DR Molecule of Known Sequence: NetMHCIIpan
note: Original NetMHCIIpan method for predicting peptide binding to HLA class II, the tool used to identify candidate C9orf72-derived T cell epitopes.

title: Improved methods for predicting peptide binding affinity to MHC class II molecules
note: Updated NetMHCII and NetMHCIIpan models with broader HLA-DR, DQ and DP coverage, the current standard for HLA class II epitope binding prediction.
